items.claim: Ryan Kus is moving up a weight class for this fight.
items.quote: He's coming up a weight class

items.claim: Marcio Barbosa is a much more dangerous striker than Ryan Kus.
items.quote: Barbosa is a way more dangerous striker than him.

items.claim: Jessa Chavez is not much of a grappler and probably will not get any takedowns against Carly Judice.
items.quote: Chavez not much of a grappler. Probably won't get any takedowns here.

items.claim: Elise Reed gets finished inside the UFC rather than just losing decisions.
items.quote: at least Reed gets finished inside the UFC. She's not just losing. She's getting put away by these ladies.

items.claim: Chanel Dyer holds a significant advantage in the striking department over Elise Reed.
items.quote: Dyer should just be much better at in the striking department.

items.claim: Ian Garry showed a lack of competitive drive and desire to win during his championship fight.
items.quote: Ian Garry didn't want to win. Ian Garry had no plans of being the UFC welterweight champion.
